en.note: group_separator is EMPTY by studio convention: a comma there reads as one-point-zero to a Russian speaker, because a comma is exactly the decimal mark ru uses.

hud.hint.ru: пустая сцена - шестеренка справа вверху открывает настройки

settings.cloud_conflict.en: Cloud save differs from this device.
settings.cloud_conflict.ru: Облачное сохранение отличается от этого устройства.

login.hint.note: Next to every login button: the portal requires the benefits stated beside the offer. Only what is true on every portal with a login: the account keeps the progress.
login.hint.en: Log in to keep your progress on your account
login.hint.ru: Войди, чтобы сохранять прогресс в аккаунте

login.button.note: Button label, offer and confirm alike. There is no logout: the portal has no such call.

login.confirm_title.note: The confirm modal after a login tap: the portal wants the benefits and a way out shown before its own dialog opens.

login.confirm_body.note: The last sentence is the way out the portal asks for. A game with a ranking adds it here.
login.confirm_body.en: Your progress is saved to your account and follows you to any device. You can keep playing without logging in.
login.confirm_body.ru: Прогресс сохранится в аккаунте и будет с тобой на любом устройстве. Играть можно и без входа.

login.later.note: The way out of the confirm modal; the game goes on as before.

settings.lang_en.note: An endonym: a language names itself the same way in every UI language.
